claim_ceiling: Synthetic workload contract only; no provider integration, measured performance, SOTA, certification, field readiness, partnership, or production claim.

comparison_arms.notes: Separate elapsed waiting time from active human labor.
Provider remains authoritative for its resources and commitments.

comparison_arms.description: Incumbent marina network or marketplace where the needed capability is actually offered
comparison_arms.notes: Unknown public capability is not a negative capability claim.

comparison_arms.description: Maritime Commons coordinating provider-owned systems through replaceable adapters

scenarios.name: Three-provider complete stay
scenarios.setup: Berth, accommodation and local-service providers have distinct source systems and independent terms.
scenarios.expected_safety_disposition: Confirm only when each mandatory provider has a current provider-authoritative commitment; optional service remains separately represented.

scenarios.name: Mandatory provider rejects
scenarios.setup: One mandatory component rejects after other components have responded.
scenarios.expected_safety_disposition: Never report a complete confirmed stay; preserve successful partial effects and obligations.

scenarios.name: Optional service rejects
scenarios.setup: Berth and accommodation commit; optional shore service rejects.
scenarios.expected_safety_disposition: Optional failure must not invalidate mandatory components; optional status remains explicit.

scenarios.name: Commit succeeds but response is lost
scenarios.setup: Provider durably commits, then transport drops response before the client observes it.
scenarios.expected_safety_disposition: Unknown or NeedsReconciliation until provider-authoritative read-back; retry cannot create a second provider effect.

scenarios.name: Duplicate and out-of-order provider events
scenarios.setup: Replay identical event IDs and deliver later revisions before earlier revisions.
scenarios.expected_safety_disposition: Deduplicate without erasing evidence; reject conflicting identity reuse; do not move state backward.

scenarios.name: Capacity-one concurrency
scenarios.setup: Two independent requests race for the same capacity-one resource and overlapping interval.
scenarios.expected_safety_disposition: Exactly one provider-authoritative commitment; the loser is not represented as confirmed.

scenarios.name: Stale offer or superseded revision
scenarios.setup: Offer/currentness revision is superseded before the final aggregate manifest is produced.
scenarios.expected_safety_disposition: Stale or superseded evidence cannot justify a positive current commitment.

scenarios.name: Adapter replacement
scenarios.setup: Replace one provider adapter while preserving provider-owned booking system and exact stay intent.
scenarios.expected_safety_disposition: Provider authority, customer relationship and inventory remain with provider; adapter cannot gain new permissions by replacement.

scenarios.name: Federation or provider partition
scenarios.setup: Network partitions after discovery and before provider commitment or reconciliation.
scenarios.expected_safety_disposition: Offline capture is not a reservation; no stale cache becomes a commitment; unresolved outcome remains explicit.

scenarios.name: Key rotation and revocation
scenarios.setup: Provider signing key rotates or is revoked while cached profile and older event are still present.
scenarios.expected_safety_disposition: Only a currently authorized key/profile can support a new accepted event; revocation cannot be bypassed by cache.

scenarios.name: Local recognition denies entitlement
scenarios.setup: Credential is validly issued but destination community does not recognize it for requested resource/purpose.
scenarios.expected_safety_disposition: Issuer authenticity is distinct from local recognition; no access entitlement is inferred.

scenarios.name: Fee mutation and refund ambiguity
scenarios.setup: Mandatory fee changes after quote; partial cancellation is followed by ambiguous refund acknowledgement.
scenarios.expected_safety_disposition: No acceptance without disclosed mandatory fees; no payment/refund finality without recognized external evidence.

scenarios.name: Purpose minimization
scenarios.setup: Compare minimal vessel/stay compatibility fields with an overbroad data request.
scenarios.expected_safety_disposition: Only purpose-authorized fields are disclosed; no unnecessary crew, identity or payment data is copied into the federation.

scenarios.name: Marina booking versus statutory clearance
scenarios.setup: A valid berth booking is present while port-entry, customs or immigration permission is absent or unknown.
scenarios.expected_safety_disposition: Booking remains a marina commitment only; no port-entry, border, pilotage, navigation or safety permission is inferred.

scenarios.name: Provider profile version and schema downgrade
scenarios.setup: Endpoint or provider profile advertises an unsupported or downgraded protocol version.
scenarios.expected_safety_disposition: Reject or quarantine unsupported/incompatible messages; no silent permissive fallback.

metric_definitions.elapsed_time: Wall-clock time from task start to justified completion or terminal unresolved state.
metric_definitions.active_human_minutes: Sum of observed participant and operator active minutes; excludes passive waiting.
metric_definitions.provider_actions: Number of actions required from provider staff, reported by role.
metric_definitions.integration_person_hours: Measured engineering and operator hours to complete declared adapter conformance.
metric_definitions.custom_mapping_rules: Count of non-reusable provider-specific semantic mapping rules.
metric_definitions.adapter_replacement_minutes: Elapsed active engineering/operator time to replace an adapter under the frozen task.
metric_definitions.fields_disclosed: Count of distinct data fields transmitted per purpose, with sensitivity classification.
metric_definitions.reconciliation_latency: Time from ambiguous effect/contradiction until justified provider-authoritative resolution.

hypotheses_not_results.statement: At least 30% lower median end-to-end coordination time than the matched manual baseline.
Adapter reuse reduces incremental provider onboarding effort as the number of connected providers grows.
Purpose-bound federation discloses fewer unnecessary personal-data fields for the same task.
A provider adapter can be replaced without moving source-of-truth inventory or customer records.

exclusions: No live provider endpoint or customer data.
No live booking, hold, cancellation or payment.
No assumption that DCSA Port Call or IHO S-100 is a recreational booking protocol.
No claim that synthetic success establishes legal, physical, safety, field or production readiness.
